elle.description: ELLE Brasil digital store for subscriptions and single magazine issues.
elle.challenge: Move magazine subscriptions and single issues online, with a simple journey aligned to the ELLE Brasil editorial ecosystem.
elle.solution: VTEX storefront with subscription flows, single-issue checkout and a newsletter capture tied to the brand operation.
elle.moreInfo: Monthly and annual subscription plans, single-issue purchases and integration with ELLE Brasil editorial content.

dpaschoal.description: Largest automotive service network in Latin America — tires, parts and services since 1949.
dpaschoal.challenge: Unify the digital journey of a national tire, parts and auto-service network, connecting the online catalog with in-store appointments.
dpaschoal.solution: VTEX store with tire search by size or vehicle, an auto-service catalog and an appointment flow.
dpaschoal.moreInfo: Tire selection by size or vehicle model, services such as oil changes, and appointment booking at physical locations.

crisBarros.description: Brazilian premium womenswear brand with a sophisticated, authorial aesthetic.
crisBarros.challenge: Carry the brand premium positioning into digital without losing its editorial identity or the ease of buying.
crisBarros.solution: VTEX storefront with an editorial storefront, product galleries and a checkout shaped for a premium fashion audience.
crisBarros.moreInfo: Product experience focused on premium womenswear, navigation by collection and checkout tied to the brand operation.

canal.description: Womenswear brand with an online store, cashback and a network of physical shops.
canal.challenge: Bring the brand proposal — elegance, authenticity and a real connection with the customer — into an omnichannel operation with physical shops.
canal.solution: Wake storefront with a seasonal vitrine, cashback program, physical-store integration and WhatsApp service.
canal.moreInfo: Seasonal collections, free shipping over R$ 599, installments up to 10x and sales assistance via WhatsApp.

fares.description: Digital platform for booking appointments, exams and surgeries in São Paulo.
fares.challenge: Make it simple to book appointments, exams and procedures for patients with different profiles and health plans, across several units.
fares.solution: Online booking portal with specialty, unit and time selection, confirmation by WhatsApp or email, and a patient area.
fares.moreInfo: Booking for appointments, lab and imaging exams, surgeries and result follow-up. Automatic confirmation by WhatsApp or email.

orit.description: E-commerce for luxury jewelry and watches on the secondhand market.
orit.challenge: Build trust in a segment where authenticity and transparency decide the purchase of high-value pieces.
orit.solution: Wake storefront with a curated selection, detailed product galleries and a buying journey shaped for a luxury audience.
orit.moreInfo: Catalog of pre-owned luxury jewelry and watches, focused on authenticity, visual detail and a premium experience.

primeGuns.description: E-commerce specialized in equipment and accessories for sport shooting.
primeGuns.challenge: Run an online store in a highly regulated segment, with documentation and compliance required at every step of the purchase.
primeGuns.solution: VTEX store with a specialized catalog, a checkout adapted to the segment rules and order handling with traceability.
primeGuns.moreInfo: Digital operation for the sport-shooting market, with a segmented catalog and a buying journey adapted to the sector rules.

leBlog.description: Contemporary womenswear e-commerce with a strong digital presence.
leBlog.challenge: Turn the brand digital audience into online sales while keeping the visual identity and the contemporary fashion proposal.
leBlog.solution: VTEX storefront with a trend-led vitrine, immersive product pages and a checkout tuned for mobile conversion.
leBlog.moreInfo: Womenswear store with a seasonal vitrine, category navigation and checkout tied to the brand operation.

goldko.description: E-commerce for premium sugar-free chocolate, focused on wellbeing.
goldko.challenge: Position a healthy-chocolate brand online and grow organic revenue without relying only on paid media.
goldko.solution: VTEX storefront with a Wicomm SEO strategy, a sugar-free product vitrine and a conversion-led buying journey.
goldko.moreInfo: Case published by Wicomm with a 179% increase in organic revenue through an e-commerce SEO strategy.

gama.description: Global beauty-tech brand — professional dryers and tools.
gama.challenge: Grow the brand organic visibility in Brazil and strengthen acquisition without relying only on paid media.
gama.solution: VTEX storefront with a Wicomm SEO strategy focused on non-brand traffic and technical store optimization.
gama.moreInfo: Case published by Wicomm with non-brand organic traffic tripled through e-commerce SEO.

toymania.description: Pioneer toy e-commerce in Brazil with multi-brand curation.
toymania.challenge: Modernize a long-running operation, migrating platforms without losing search position or the customer base.
toymania.solution: Migration to VTEX with URL mapping, SEO preservation and a storefront rebuilt for better performance.
toymania.moreInfo: Platform migration with URL redirects, SEO structure kept intact and a multi-brand toy vitrine.

amakha.description: Cosmetics and fragrance e-commerce with a direct-sales model.
amakha.challenge: Structure the digital operation of a direct-sales brand, serving resellers and end customers on the same platform.
amakha.solution: VTEX store with a reseller portal, checkout for the end customer and catalog management for cosmetics and fragrance.
amakha.moreInfo: Digital operation for direct sales of cosmetics, with an area for resellers and a store for the end customer.

capodarte.description: Premium footwear and bags e-commerce with Brazilian craft tradition.
capodarte.challenge: Bring the brand premium positioning online, highlighting handcrafted finishing and footwear and bag collections.
capodarte.solution: VTEX storefront with high-resolution product galleries, editorial collection pages and checkout for a premium audience.
capodarte.moreInfo: Premium footwear and bags vitrine, galleries with zoom on product detail and navigation by seasonal collections.

farm.description: International expansion of FARM across Latin America with local stores.
farm.challenge: Take FARM into new Latin American markets with a localized buying experience — currency, language, payment and logistics.
farm.solution: Multi-country rollout with VTEX IO, Wicomm UX/UI, local payment gateways and regional logistics partners.
farm.moreInfo: Case published by Wicomm: expansion to six Latin American countries in 45 days with VTEX IO and a localized experience.

csp.description: Visual generator of Content Security Policies for web apps.
csp.challenge: Make Content Security Policies easier to write — a technical, error-prone task that either blocks resources or leaves security gaps.
csp.solution: Visual generator with presets by app type, real-time validation and export as an HTTP header or a meta tag.
csp.moreInfo: Open-source work (cspForge repository on GitHub) with templates for popular frameworks and an explanation of each CSP directive.

wakeRunner.description: CLI published on npm to start Wake Commerce work locally.
wakeRunner.challenge: Automate the local setup of Wake work, which required starting the storefront and the CSS watchers by hand on every dev session.
wakeRunner.solution: CLI that reads the token in Configs/settings.json, starts fbits.storefront and the Tailwind watchers for each input*.css in Assets/CSS/.
wakeRunner.moreInfo: Automates fbits.storefront and tailwindcss --watch. Works on Windows (wake-storefront / wake-tailwind) and other systems.

wakeMcp.description: MCP server to query and inspect the Wake Storefront API (FBITS) GraphQL.
wakeMcp.challenge: Let AI agents query the Wake GraphQL schema during development, without external clients or guessing field names.
wakeMcp.solution: MCP server with four tools — query, introspection with a TTL cache, type detail and field search — configured via JSON or environment variables.
wakeMcp.moreInfo: In-memory introspection cache, support for the TCS-Access-Token and compatibility with Claude Desktop and Cursor.

treplica.description: Local meeting assistant with transcription, AI suggestions and live translation.
treplica.challenge: Offer reply suggestions in real time during meetings without sending audio or transcripts to external servers.
treplica.solution: Desktop app with Tauri and React that captures audio locally, transcribes in many languages, generates AI guidance and shows a stealth overlay in the meeting.
treplica.moreInfo: v0.1.1-beta.2 — Windows 10/11, macOS 12+ and Linux. Overlay hidden from Zoom, Meet and Teams. No cloud uploads.
